question: Why are those who torment the body and the Lord within called demonic?
premises: They torment the unconscious element-group and the Lord within the body.
They are connected to faith turning toward other activity.
They fashion self-made austerity and are tamasic.
inference: Their conduct is demonic because it lacks scriptural practice and self-knowledge.
uncertainties: Several fused commentary tokens are kept as single rows.
plain_english: Those who torment the body and the Lord within are demonic; they are connected to faith turned elsewhere, fashion self-made austerity, and are tamasic.
